evidence.detail: preaggregate_card() uses SELECT DISTINCT card, deck_id FROM deck_card, preventing main/side double counting; comment explicitly references prior fix #5493
2019 fix 'Prevent double-counting of cards in both main and board in card stats' for the same preaggregate path
season_join() is LEFT JOIN deck_cache (UNIQUE on deck_id), 1:1; nwdl_join() groups by deck id, 1:1 — no join can create additional rows per card+deck pair

triage.notes: The preaggregate has had the DISTINCT fix since 2019 and all joins are 1:1. Commit f6cd810c (Oct 2024) separately fixed a surviving double-count on the per-competition cards page (load_competition_cards), which is a different code path from the main /cards/ listing; that path was still broken when this issue was filed in May 2023 and could explain the report if the reporter was looking at a competition page.
